newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei ends off lows, steady rates seen.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei ends off lows, steady rates seen.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended lower on Wednesday but off their day's low after the Bank of Japan (BOJ)'s tankan reaffirmed expectations of a steady rate policy in the near-term, dealer said.
"Initially, there was not much of a reaction to the tankan which was more or less within expectations," a dealer with a Japanese institution said.
"But with majority believing the BOJ would not change its policy, Japanese bonds and Euroyen rallied, pulling along indirectly the Nikkei," he said.
On Wednesday, BOJ's tankan survey of business sentiment showed the key diffusion index for big manufacturers at minus three for November against minus seven in its August survey.
SIMEX Nikkei 225 December contract ended 30 points above its support level at 21,330 on a turnover of 20,000 lots.
Some dealers were optimistic the contract might now look to test 21,500-22,000 in the intermediate term since it closed above its technical support of 21,300.
